[gold]Spell[/gold]: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the damage dealt.

STS2WD-REALTA_RUSHING_BLADES.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
[gold]Spell[/gold]: Hit ALL enemies instead.
STS2WD-REALTA_SHOCKING_TOUCH.title: Shocking Touch
STS2WD-REALTA_STEEL_PINCERS.title: Steel Pincers

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Upgrade[/gold] {Cards:diff()} random card(s) in your hand.
STS2WD-REALTA_SPARRING.title: Sparring
STS2WD-REALTA_FLYING_CHARGE.title: Flying Charge
STS2WD-REALTA_FLYING_CHARGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Damage is also affected by the target's [gold]Strength[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_THUNDER_BLADE.title: Thunder Blade
STS2WD-REALTA_HONING.title: Honing
STS2WD-REALTA_RECLAIM.title: Reclaim
STS2WD-REALTA_RECLAIM.description:
Return ALL [gold]Flying Glaives[/gold] to your hand from any combat pile.
Add 1 copy with [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] to your hand.
STS2WD-REALTA_EMERGENCY_REPAIRS.title: Emergency Repairs
STS2WD-REALTA_EMERGENCY_REPAIRS.descript:
Draw {Cards:diff()} card(s).
Enchant a card in your hand with [gold]Steady[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_MAGIC_MENDING.title: Magic Mending
STS2WD-REALTA_MAGIC_MENDING.description: Return a card from your discard pile to your hand, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it, then enchant it with [gold]Steady[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_MAGIC_MENDING.selectionScr: Choose a card to return to your hand.
STS2WD-REALTA_WELL_PREPARED.title: Well Prepared
STS2WD-REALTA_WELL_PREPARED.description: At the start of your next turn, gain {RealtaVigorNextTurnPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold] and draw {Cards:diff()} additional card(s).
STS2WD-REALTA_EQUIPMENT_CARE.title: Equipment Care
STS2WD-REALTA_BARRIER.title: Barrier
STS2WD-REALTA_SNATCH.title: Snatch
STS2WD-REALTA_MY_NAME_IS.title: My Name Is!
STS2WD-REALTA_MY_NAME_IS.description:
Gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], equal to ALL enemies' total [gold]Block[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_FAERIE_FIRE.title: Faerie Fire
STS2WD-REALTA_FAERIE_BRONZE.title: Faerie Bronze
STS2WD-REALTA_VALOR.title: Valor
STS2WD-REALTA_MAGIC_WEAPON.title: Magic Weapon
STS2WD-REALTA_OLD_CHISEL.title: Old Chisel
STS2WD-REALTA_OLD_CHISEL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

STS2WD-REALTA_DIMENSIONAL_CHARGE.title: Dimensional Charge
STS2WD-REALTA_PINCER_ATTACK.title: Pincer Attack
STS2WD-REALTA_PINCER_ATTACK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you played a [gold]Steel Guardian[/gold] this turn, hit twice.
STS2WD-REALTA_DRAGON_SCALE.title: Dragon Scale
STS2WD-REALTA_SELF_REPAIR.title: Self Repair
STS2WD-REALTA_SELF_REPAIR.description:
Return ALL [gold]Steel Guardians[/gold] to your hand from any combat pile.
[gold]Guard[/gold] {Guard:diff()}.
STS2WD-REALTA_HAMMERING.title: Hammering
STS2WD-REALTA_HAMMERING.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} card(s) and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] them.
Gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold] for each drawn card that was already Upgraded.
STS2WD-REALTA_ANNEALING.title: Annealing
STS2WD-REALTA_ANNEALING.description:
Discard any number of cards from your hand, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] them, then [gold]Refine[/gold] them {Refine:diff()}.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] Unplayable cards instead.
STS2WD-REALTA_ANNEALING.selectionScreenP: Choose any number of cards to discard.
STS2WD-REALTA_MENDING.title: Mending
STS2WD-REALTA_KNIGHTS_OATH.title: Knight's Oath
STS2WD-REALTA_CHIVALRY.title: Chivalry
STS2WD-REALTA_SPATIAL_WARP.title: Spatial Warp
STS2WD-REALTA_SPATIAL_WARP.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Spell[/gold]: This turn, blocked attack damage is reflected back at the attacker.
STS2WD-REALTA_SMELTING.title: Smelting
STS2WD-REALTA_SMELTING.description:
Return {Cards:diff()} card(s) from your discard pile to your hand, then [gold]Upgrade[/gold] ALL cards in your hand.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] any cards that cannot be Upgraded.
STS2WD-REALTA_SMELTING.selectionScreenPr: Choose card(s) to return to your hand.
STS2WD-REALTA_DAMAGE_IMMUNITY.title: Damage Immunity
STS2WD-REALTA_AURA_OF_VIGOR.title: Aura of Vigor
STS2WD-REALTA_FATHERS_ADVICE.title: Father's Advice
STS2WD-REALTA_FATHERS_ADVICE.description:
At the start of your turn, [gold]Guard[/gold] {Guard:diff()}.
Whenever you play [gold]Steel Guardian[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} card(s).
STS2WD-REALTA_FIRST_DUEL.title: First Duel
STS2WD-REALTA_FIRST_DUEL.description: Whenever an enemy gains [gold]Strength[/gold] or [gold]Block[/gold], gain the same amount of that type.
STS2WD-REALTA_WITCHS_SECRET_ART.title: Witch's Secret Art
STS2WD-REALTA_WITCHS_SECRET_ART.descript: Whenever you trigger a [gold]Spell[/gold] effect, draw {Cards:diff()} additional card(s) at the start of your next turn.
STS2WD-REALTA_JOUSTING.title: Jousting
STS2WD-REALTA_JOUSTING.description: Gain [gold]Vigor[/gold] equal to the attack damage you block.
STS2WD-REALTA_OLD_WORKSHOP.title: Old Workshop
STS2WD-REALTA_OLD_WORKSHOP.description: Whenever you [gold]Refine[/gold] or [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a card, gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_WORTHY_RIVAL.title: Worthy Rival
STS2WD-REALTA_WORTHY_RIVAL.description: At the start of your turn, if any enemy has [gold]Strength[/gold] or [gold]Block[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} additional card(s).
STS2WD-REALTA_HEROS_ARMOR.title: Hero's Armor
STS2WD-REALTA_HEROS_ARMOR.description: Whenever you [gold]Refine[/gold] a card, gain the same amount of [gold]Block[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_FORGE_HEAT.title: Forge Heat
STS2WD-REALTA_FORGE_HEAT.description: Whenever you draw an [gold]Upgraded[/gold] card, gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_LUCKY_NECKLACE.title: Lucky Necklace
STS2WD-REALTA_LUCKY_NECKLACE.description: At the end of combat, gain an additional card reward.
STS2WD-REALTA_GREAT_FLAME.title: Great Flame
STS2WD-REALTA_GREAT_FLAME.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Costs {Energy:diff()} less if you have [gold]Vigor[/gold].
Costs {Energy:diff()} less if you have [gold]Flame Barrier[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_FIRE_DRAGONS_BLOOD.title: Fire Dragon's Blood
STS2WD-REALTA_MOTE_OF_FLAME.title: Mote of Flame
STS2WD-REALTA_MOTE_OF_FLAME.description:
[gold]Masterwork[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
While in your hand, whenever a card other than [gold]Mote of Flame[/gold] is [gold]Upgraded[/gold] or [gold]Refined[/gold], this card is also [gold]Upgraded[/gold] or [gold]Refined[/gold], respectively.
STS2WD-REALTA_MOUNTAIN_SPLITTER.title: Mountain Splitter
STS2WD-REALTA_MOUNTAIN_SPLITTER.descript: Gain [gold]Vigor[/gold] equal to the total [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Block[/gold] of ALL enemies, then deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
STS2WD-REALTA_FORCE_MAW.title: Force Maw
STS2WD-REALTA_FORCE_MAW.description: Deal damage equal to [gold]Steel Guardian[/gold]'s Block.
STS2WD-REALTA_RINNAL_BODB_DEARG.title: Rinnal Bodb Dearg
STS2WD-REALTA_RINNAL_BODB_DEARG.descript:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of your next turn.
STS2WD-REALTA_FINEST_KNIGHT.title: Finest Knight
STS2WD-REALTA_FINEST_KNIGHT.description:
Gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold] for each [gold]Upgraded[/gold] card in your hand.
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold] for each Enchanted card in your hand.
STS2WD-REALTA_BLESSING_OF_FIRE.title: Blessing of Fire
STS2WD-REALTA_BLESSING_OF_FIRE.descripti: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, and double your [gold]Vigor[/gold] and [gold]Flame Barrier[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_DRAGON_WINGS.title: Dragon Wings
STS2WD-REALTA_DRAGON_WINGS.description: Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold], then gain [gold]Flame Barrier[/gold] equal to your [gold]Plating[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_UNDYING_LOYALTY.title: Undying Loyalty
STS2WD-REALTA_UNDYING_LOYALTY.descriptio:
[gold]Guard[/gold] {Guard:diff()}.
This turn, your [gold]Steel Guardians[/gold] are played twice.
STS2WD-REALTA_BOUNDARY_REFORGING.title: Boundary Reforging
STS2WD-REALTA_BOUNDARY_REFORGING.descrip: Return a card from your Exhaust pile to your hand, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it, then [gold]Refine[/gold] it {Refine:diff()}.
STS2WD-REALTA_BOUNDARY_REFORGING.selecti: Choose a card to return to your hand.
STS2WD-REALTA_DRAGONS_FOOTSTEPS.title: Dragon's Footsteps
STS2WD-REALTA_DRAGONS_FOOTSTEPS.descript: Whenever you consume [gold]Vigor[/gold], gain the same amount of [gold]Flame Barrier[/gold] and [gold]Block[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_PRIMAL_FORM.title: Primal Form
STS2WD-REALTA_PRIMAL_FORM.description: Whenever you [gold]Refine[/gold] a card, [gold]Guard[/gold] by the same amount.
STS2WD-REALTA_GRANNS_BLESSING.title: Grann's Blessing
STS2WD-REALTA_GRANNS_BLESSING.descriptio: The first time you trigger a [gold]Spell[/gold] effect each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
STS2WD-REALTA_GOIBNIUS_FORGING.title: Goibniu's Magical Reforging
STS2WD-REALTA_GOIBNIUS_FORGING.descripti: Whenever you [gold]Refine[/gold], increase its amount by {RefineBonus:diff()}.
STS2WD-REALTA_FAERIE_ARTISAN.title: Faerie Artisan
STS2WD-REALTA_FAERIE_ARTISAN.description: Whenever you [gold]Upgrade[/gold] or [gold]Refine[/gold] a card, it gains [gold]Retain[/gold] this turn.
STS2WD-REALTA_INDOMITABLE.title: Indomitable
STS2WD-REALTA_INDOMITABLE.description: At the start of your turn, if you lost HP last turn, gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_AGDRIDS_ANVIL.title: Agdrid's Anvil
STS2WD-REALTA_AGDRIDS_ANVIL.description: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] ALL cards in your draw pile and [gold]Refine[/gold] them {Refine:diff()}.
STS2WD-REALTA_STEEL_PREDATOR.title: Steel Predator
STS2WD-REALTA_IORDINA_MAC_BETHLEHEM.desc:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Return this card to your hand after it is played.
STS2WD-REALTA_GENIUS_INSPIRATION.title: Genius Inspiration
STS2WD-REALTA_GENIUS_INSPIRATION.descrip: At the end of combat, choose a card in your deck and permanently [gold]Refine[/gold] it {Refine:diff()}.
STS2WD-REALTA_HEROIC_CHARGE.title: Heroic Charge!
STS2WD-REALTA_HEROIC_CHARGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Discard your hand.
STS2WD-REALTA_MATERIAL_ANALYSIS.title: Material Analysis
STS2WD-REALTA_MATERIAL_ANALYSIS.descript:
Shuffle ALL [gold]Upgraded[/gold] or enchanted cards in your discard pile into your draw pile.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
STS2WD-REALTA_IMPROVISED_WEAPON.title: Improvised Weapon
STS2WD-REALTA_IMPROVISED_WEAPON.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Choose 1 of 3 random {Upgraded:cond:>0?[gold]Upgraded[/gold] |}Skills to add to your hand.
It gains [gold]Adroit[/gold] equal to this card's [gold]Sharp[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_HEROISM.title: Heroism
STS2WD-REALTA_MASTERPIECE.title: Masterpiece
STS2WD-REALTA_MASTERPIECE.description:
Choose a card in your hand and discard the rest.
[gold]Refine[/gold] the chosen card {Refine:diff()}.
STS2WD-REALTA_MAKESHIFT.title: Makeshift
STS2WD-REALTA_MAKESHIFT.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in your hand.
Choose 1 of 3 random {Upgraded:cond:>0?[gold]Upgraded[/gold] |}Colorless cards to add to your hand.
STS2WD-REALTA_MAJESTIC.title: Majestic
STS2WD-REALTA_PERFECT_DAY.title: Perfect Day
STS2WD-REALTA_PERFECT_DAY.description:
Whenever you spend a total of 10 [gold]Vigor[/gold], gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
Excess spending carries over.
STS2WD-REALTA_PORTABLE_FORGE.title: Portable Forge
STS2WD-REALTA_PORTABLE_FORGE.description:
[gold]Refine[/gold] each player's next card {Refine:diff()} before it is played.
Stacks combine and are consumed even if the card cannot be [gold]Refined[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_ALMENELS_BULWARK.title: Almenel's Bulwark
STS2WD-REALTA_ALMENELS_BULWARK.descripti:
Gain {Plating:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
This amount increases with this card's [gold]Adroit[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_HEROS_SILHOUETTE.title: Hero's Silhouette
STS2WD-REALTA_HEROS_SILHOUETTE.descripti:
The first time you [gold]Upgrade[/gold] each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
The first time you [gold]Refine[/gold] each turn, draw {Cards:diff()} card(s).
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RAGE_STRIKE.title: Rage Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SIARCUN.title: Siarcun
STS2WD-ALTHEA_LLEURH.title: Lleurh
STS2WD-ALTHEA_MORFIELLA.title: Morfiella
STS2WD-ALTHEA_PURE_WILL.title: Pure Will
STS2WD-ALTHEA_WRAITH.title: Wraith
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RECKLESS_STRIKE.title: Reckless Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RECKLESS_STRIKE.descriptio: Apply {Amount:diff()} Vulnerable. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Amount:diff()} Vulnerable.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_HEAVY_STRIKE.title: Heavy Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_HEAVY_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. When added to your deck, add a Doubt.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FRENZIED_STRIKE.title: Frenzied Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DEATH_STRIKE.title: Death Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DEATH_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Clash: Deal double damage.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SURGING_STRIKE.title: Surging Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SURGING_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw a card for each Attack played this turn, including this card.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ANNIHILATING_STRIKE.title: Annihilating Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ANNIHILATING_STRIKE.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies twice.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DOGGED_STRIKE.title: Dogged Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DOGGED_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Can only be played if you have another Curse in your hand.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_HAUNTED_STRIKE.title: Haunted Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_HAUNTED_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Add a Wraith to your hand.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DESPERATE_STRIKE.title: Desperate Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_WARRIOR_STRIKE.title: Warrior Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_KARMIC_MADNESS.title: Karmic Madness
STS2WD-ALTHEA_KARMIC_MADNESS.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. When added to your deck, add a Shame.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DEFLECT.title: Deflect
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DEFLECT.description: Discard an Attack. Gain Block equal to its displayed total damage (X counts as 0).
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ANCESTRAL_GRUDGE.title: Ancestral Grudge
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ANCESTRAL_GRUDGE.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Add a Wraith to your discard pile.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CURSE_OF_NO_RETREAT.title: Curse Of No Retreat
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CURSE_OF_NO_RETREAT.descri: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Shuffle 2 Wraiths into your draw pile.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SOUL_ADVICE.title: Soul Advice
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SOUL_ADVICE.description: Exhaust {Amount:diff()} random other cards in your hand. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SELF_DISCIPLINE.title: Self Discipline
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SELF_DISCIPLINE.descriptio: Gain Block equal to your Exhaust pile size{Upgraded:cond:>0? plus your discard pile size|}.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RISING_MADNESS.title: Rising Madness
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RISING_MADNESS.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Exhaust all non-Attacks drawn.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_UNDEFEATED.title: Undefeated
STS2WD-ALTHEA_BATTLE_INSTINCT.title: Battle Instinct
STS2WD-ALTHEA_BATTLE_INSTINCT.descriptio: This turn, whenever you play an Attack, draw 1 card.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_REVIEW.title: Review
STS2WD-ALTHEA_REVIEW.description: Return a card from your discard pile to your hand.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SHARKS_TOOTH.title: Sharks Tooth
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SHARKS_TOOTH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Your next Attack costs 0.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_LIONS_LEAP.title: Lions Leap
STS2WD-ALTHEA_LIONS_LEAP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Your next Attack deals double damage.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ORCAS_AMBUSH.title: Orcas Ambush
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ORCAS_AMBUSH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Your next Attack grants Block equal to the damage it deals.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DISARM.title: Disarm
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DISARM.description: This turn, each attack hit reduces the target's Strength by {Amount:diff()} this turn. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_PIERCING_HARPOON.title: Piercing Harpoon
STS2WD-ALTHEA_PIERCING_HARPOON.descripti: Remove the target's Block. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SLAUGHTER.title: Slaughter
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SLAUGHTER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Gain 1 Vulnerable.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_BLOOD_SEA.title: Blood Sea
STS2WD-ALTHEA_BLOOD_SEA.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you have a harmful effect, hit ALL enemies instead.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_REVENANTS_REVENGE.title: Revenants Revenge
STS2WD-ALTHEA_REVENANTS_REVENGE.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy, then repeat for each Curse in your Exhaust pile.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SCABBARD_SWING.title: Scabbard Swing
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SCABBARD_SWING.description: Discard an Attack. Deal its displayed total damage to ALL enemies (X counts as 0).
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FEINT.title: Feint
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FEINT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy. Draw 1 card. Whenever this card is reshuffled, increase its cost by 1 this combat.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SOUL_SHIELD.title: Soul Shield
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SOUL_SHIELD.description: Exhaust all other cards in your hand. Gain {Block:diff()} Block per card Exhausted.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_BREAKTHROUGH.title: Breakthrough
STS2WD-ALTHEA_BREAKTHROUGH.description: Clash: Choose a card from your draw pile to put in your hand.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FLEET_FOOT.title: Fleet Foot
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FLEET_FOOT.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. At the start of your next turn, draw {Cards:diff()} cards unless you shuffle first.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_INSTINCTIVE_DEFENSE.title: Instinctive Defense
STS2WD-ALTHEA_INSTINCTIVE_DEFENSE.descri: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If you have Frail, gain it twice.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_UNDYING_RAGE.title: Undying Rage
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RATIONAL_WILL.title: Moment of Calm
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RATIONAL_WILL.description: Reform any number of other cards in your hand.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_BLOODLUST.title: Bloodlust
STS2WD-ALTHEA_WHISPERING_WRAITH.title: Whispering Wraith
STS2WD-ALTHEA_WHISPERING_WRAITH.descript: Add 2 Wraiths to your hand. Gain {Block:diff()} Block for each Curse in your hand.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RESTLESS_MADNESS.title: Restless Madness
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RESTLESS_MADNESS.descripti: At the end of combat, heal 1 HP for each unexhausted Curse.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SHARK_STANCE.title: Shark Stance
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SHARK_STANCE.description: Whenever you play 3 Attacks consecutively in a turn, draw {Amount:diff()} cards.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_LION_STANCE.title: Lion Stance
STS2WD-ALTHEA_LION_STANCE.description: Whenever you play an Attack, gain {Amount:diff()} Strength this turn.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ORCA_STANCE.title: Orca Stance
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ORCA_STANCE.description: Whenever you play an Attack, gain {Amount:diff()} Dexterity this turn.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SOUL_HEAT.title: Soul Heat
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SOUL_HEAT.description: Gain 1 Strength per Exhausted Curse, including Curses Exhausted later.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CURSE_HARVEST.title: Curse Harvest
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CURSE_HARVEST.description: Whenever you draw a Curse, draw 1 card.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_IMMORTAL_OBSESSION.title: Immortal Obsession
STS2WD-ALTHEA_IMMORTAL_OBSESSION.descrip: Whenever a Curse is generated or Exhausted, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FIGHTING_SPIRIT.title: Endless Fighting Spirit
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FIGHTING_SPIRIT.descriptio: At the start of each turn, Clash: Gain {Amount:energyIcons()}.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_PATH_TO_GREATNESS.title: Path To Greatness
STS2WD-ALTHEA_PATH_TO_GREATNESS.descript: Each turn, Reform your first played card and put it on top of your draw pile. If it Exhausts, Exhaust the replacement instead.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FIRST_WAVE.title: First Wave
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FIRST_WAVE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy 3 times.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RAWENAID.title: Rawenaid
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RAWENAID.description: Discard all other Attacks in your hand. Deal their displayed total damage to ALL enemies (X counts as 0).
STS2WD-ALTHEA_GEN_MORFI_CLAD.title: Gen Morfi Clad
STS2WD-ALTHEA_GEN_MORFI_CLAD.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy, then repeat once per distinct harmful effect you have.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ULTIMATE_STRIKE.title: Ultimate Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ULTIMATE_STRIKE.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Fatal: Add a copy to your permanent deck.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_STRIKE.title: Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DEFEND.title: Defend
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CRUSHING_STRIKE.title: Crushing Strike
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CRUSHING_STRIKE.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {Amount:diff()} Weak. Gain {Amount:diff()} Frail.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_STRUGGLE.title: Struggle
STS2WD-ALTHEA_STRUGGLE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Play {Amount:diff()} random Attacks from your draw pile, then Exhaust them.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_REGROUP.title: Regroup
STS2WD-ALTHEA_REGROUP.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Whenever this card is reshuffled, increase its cost by 1 this combat.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_OVERCOME.title: Overcome
STS2WD-ALTHEA_OVERCOME.description: At the end of your turn, if you have a harmful effect, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CURSED_BLADE_FATE.title: Cursed Blade Fate
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CURSED_BLADE_FATE.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Whenever this card is Exhausted, it returns Upgraded.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_BLOOD_WHISPER.title: Blood Whisper
STS2WD-ALTHEA_BLOOD_WHISPER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw Curses from your draw pile until your hand is full.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DEMONIC_BLADE.title: Demonic Blade
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DEMONIC_BLADE.description: Apply {Amount:diff()} Weak and Vulnerable to ALL enemies and yourself.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_LIBERATION.title: Liberation
STS2WD-ALTHEA_LIBERATION.description: Reform all cards in your discard pile.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_GATHERING_SOULS.title: Gathering Souls
STS2WD-ALTHEA_GATHERING_SOULS.descriptio: Add {Amount:diff()} Wraiths to your hand. Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each Curse in your hand.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_VESSEL_OF_DELUSION.title: Vessel Of Delusion
STS2WD-ALTHEA_VESSEL_OF_DELUSION.descrip: Gain {Block:diff()} Block X times. Shuffle X Wraiths into your draw pile.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RESOLUTE_WILL.title: Resolute Will
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RESOLUTE_WILL.description:
Reform 1 card in your Hand.
Cards Reformed this turn play twice and Exhaust.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_WARRIORS_CREED.title: Warriors Creed
STS2WD-ALTHEA_WARRIORS_CREED.description: Gain {Amount:diff()} Strength and Dexterity until you shuffle. Shuffle this card into your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_INNER_RESERVE.title: Inner Reserve
STS2WD-ALTHEA_INNER_RESERVE.description:
Whenever a harmful effect is removed, gain {Amount:energyIcons()} next turn.
Remove all Vulnerable and Frail from yourself.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_UNRIVALED_BLADE.title: Unrivaled Blade
STS2WD-ALTHEA_UNRIVALED_BLADE.descriptio: Weak increases your attack damage instead of reducing it.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SOUL_LEGION.title: Soul Legion
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SOUL_LEGION.description: Whenever you play an Attack, it gains Frenzy this combat.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ARCHIPELAGO_ARTS.title: Archipelago Arts
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ARCHIPELAGO_ARTS.descripti: Whenever you spend {energyPrefix:energyIcons(3)} on Reformed cards or Attacks, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SEA_WARRIOR.title: Sea Warrior
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SEA_WARRIOR.description: At the start of each turn, return a card from your discard pile to your hand.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_EROSION_CURSE.title: Erosion Curse
STS2WD-ALTHEA_EROSION_CURSE.description: When you would die, heal 30% of your maximum HP, gain {Amount:diff()} Strength, and remove this effect.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SOUL_VEIL.title: Soul Veil
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SOUL_VEIL.description: ALL players add {Amount:diff()} Wraiths to their hands.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CURSE_DOMINION.title: Curse Dominion
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CURSE_DOMINION.description: Take all Curses from all other players' hands, draw piles, and discard piles for this combat and put them into your discard pile.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SEA_PARTING.title: Part the Sea
STS2WD-ALTHEA_SEA_PARTING.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Costs 1 less for each Curse in your discard and Exhaust piles.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FINAL_BLOW.title: Final Blow
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FINAL_BLOW.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Costs 1 less for each Attack played by ALL players this turn.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FIGHTERS_FORM.title: Fighter's Form
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FIGHTERS_FORM.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Amount:energyIcons()}. Increase this Energy gain by {Amount:energyIcons()} each turn until you shuffle your deck.
STS2WD-ASELIGE_SHINING_LEAF.title: Shining Leaf
STS2WD-ASELIGE_VERDANT_DRAGON_ADVENT.des: A placeholder card with no effect.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RESOLVE.description: Whenever you receive a harmful effect, gain {Amount:diff()} Strength and draw 1 card.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DESPERATE_EFFORT.descripti:
Gain {Amount:energyIcons()}. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Skip your normal hand draw next turn.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_RESOLVE.title: Resolve
STS2WD-ALTHEA_DESPERATE_EFFORT.title: Desperate Effort
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FADED_CREST.description: Whenever a Curse is Exhausted, gain {Amount:energyIcons()} next turn. When added to your Deck, add a Folly to your Deck.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FADED_CREST.title: Faded Crest
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TUNE_FROM_HAND.title: Tune: From Hand
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TUNE_FROM_HAND.descript: Put 1 card from your Hand on top of your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TUNE_FROM_HAND.selectio: Choose a card to put on top of your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TUNE_FROM_DISCARD.title: Tune: From Discard
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TUNE_FROM_DISCARD.descr: Put 1 card from your Discard Pile on top of your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TUNE_FROM_DISCARD.selec: Choose a card to put on top of your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TUNE_SHUFFLE.title: Tune: Shuffle
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TUNE_SHUFFLE.descriptio: Shuffle all cards in your Discard Pile into your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_WARRIOR_TALE.title: Warrior Tale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_HERO_TALE.title: Hero Tale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_HERO_TALE.description:
[gold]Refine[/gold] 1 card in your Hand {Refine:diff()}.
[gold]Reenact[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:an upgraded|a} Realta card.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ESCAPE_TALE.title: Escape Tale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_WILD_TALE.title: Wild Tale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_BEAST_TALE.title: Beast Tale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_BEAST_TALE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Reenact[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:an upgraded|an} Attack with an original cost of 0.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FRIENDSHIP_TALE.title: Friendship Tale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_REVENGE_TALE.title: Revenge Tale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_DARK_TALE.title: Dark Tale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FAIRY_TALE.title: Fairy Tale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_UNKNOWN_TALE.title: Unknown Tale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_UNKNOWN_TALE.descriptio: [gold]Reenact[/gold] a card from another player's Deck.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ANGEL_TALE.title: Angel Tale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_STORY_COLLECTION.title: Story Collector
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_STORY_COLLECTION.descri: After victory, [gold]Reenact[/gold] an off-color card you manually played this combat and add it to your Deck.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_OLD_MANDOLIN.title: Old Mandolin
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ILLUSORY_STAND_IN.title: Illusory Stand-In
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ILLUSORY_STAND_IN.descr:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Add an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of a card in your Hand to your Hand.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_LEGENDARY_WEAPON.title: Legendary Weapon
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_LEGENDARY_WEAPON.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, twice if you have an off-color card in your Hand.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FATEFUL_STRIKE.title: Fateful Strike
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FATEFUL_STRIKE.descript: Draw 1 card. If it is an Attack, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_DRAMATIC_ENDING.title: Dramatic Ending
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_AGGRESSIVE_TAUNT.title: Aggressive Taunt
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_AGGRESSIVE_TAUNT.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw 1 card.
Costs 0 if you have [gold]Tuned[/gold] this turn.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ILLUSORY_BINDING.title: Illusory Binding
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FLAME_WHIP.title: Flame Whip
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FLAME_WHIP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy. Repeat this damage effect the next time you play an off-color card this turn.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_PIERCING_LIGHT.title: Piercing Light
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_DISSONANT_WHISPER.title: Dissonant Whisper
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_DISSONANT_WHISPER.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} Vulnerable. Apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak to all other enemies.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TERRIBLE_LAUGHTER.title: Terrible Laughter
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TERRIBLE_LAUGHTER.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of this card to your Hand.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_SORROW.title: Song of Sorrow
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_SORROW.descript: When drawn, a random enemy loses {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SLEIGHT_OF_HAND.title: Sleight of Hand
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SLEIGHT_OF_HAND.descrip: Put {Cards:diff()} cards from your Hand on the bottom of your Draw Pile. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SLEIGHT_OF_HAND.selecti: Choose cards to put on the bottom of your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_ELATION.title: Song of Inspiration
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_ELATION.descrip: When drawn, Upgrade {Cards:diff()} random other cards in your Hand.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_MAP.title: Map
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_MAP.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
After this card, cards played this turn go on top of your Draw Pile instead of your Discard Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_JOY.title: Song of Joy
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_MIRROR_IMAGE.title: Mirror Image
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_INVISIBILITY.title: Invisibility
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_INVISIBILITY.descriptio: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Add an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of this card to your Hand.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_HEALING_HAND.title: Healing Hand
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_HEALING_HAND.descriptio: Give [gold]Ethereal[/gold] to {IfUpgraded:show:any number of cards|1 card} in your Hand.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SHINING_SOUL.title: Shining Soul
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_LEGENDARY_BLOW.title: Legendary Blow
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_LEGENDARY_BLOW.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Discard all off-color cards in your Hand and repeat once per card discarded.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ESTRIDS_THUNDER.title: Estrid's Thunder
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ESTRIDS_THUNDER.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
[gold]Dominion[/gold]: Deal damage twice.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_CHOOSING_FATE.title: Choosing Fate
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_CHOOSING_FATE.descripti: Draw 1 card. Keep drawing until you draw a card of a different type.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_SOULS.title: Song of Souls
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_BEWILDERMENT.de: When drawn, apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_SLEEP.title: Song of Sleep
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_SLEEP.descripti: When drawn, apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak to ALL enemies.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_INSTRUMENT_TUNING.title: Instrument Tuning
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_MYSTIC_ENDING.title: Mystic Ending
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_HAPPY_ENDING.title: Happy Ending
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_CONVERSATION_WITH_THE_D: Put {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} cards from your Exhaust Pile on top of your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_DISPEL_MAGIC.title: Dispel Magic
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_DISPEL_MAGIC.descriptio: Remove all Block, Strength, Plating, and Artifact from an enemy.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_MOOD_ADJUSTMENT.title: Mood Adjustment
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_MOOD_ADJUSTMENT.descrip: At the end of your turn, put 1 card from your Hand on top of your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FINAL_ACT.title: Final Act
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FINAL_ACT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Costs 1 more per card in your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FATE_IN_THE_CARDS.title: Fate in Hand
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FATE_IN_THE_CARDS.descr: Draw 1 card. Gain [gold]Energy[/gold] equal to its current cost.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_MADNESS.title: Song of Madness
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_MADNESS.descrip: When drawn, {IfUpgraded:show:ALL enemies lose|a random enemy loses} HP equal to the combined intended attack damage of all enemies.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_CELESTIAL_SONG.title: Celestial Song
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_FATE.title: Song of Fate
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_FATE.descriptio: When drawn, put 1 card from your {IfUpgraded:show:Draw|Discard} Pile into your Hand.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_I_ALONE.title: I Alone
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_I_ALONE.description: Whenever another player generates a card, add an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy to your Hand.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_STRIKE.title: Strike
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_DEFEND.title: Defend
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_MISERABLE_ENDING.title: Miserable Ending
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_MIND_SPEAR.title: Mind Spear
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_MIND_SPEAR.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. The target loses additional HP equal to the unblocked damage dealt.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_WORDS_OF_SOULS.title: Words of Souls
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_WORDS_OF_SOULS.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Whenever one of your [gold]Ethereal[/gold] cards is Exhausted, return this card from your Discard Pile to your Hand.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_HEAVENLY_MIGHT.title: Heavenly Might
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_RAPID_PASSAGE.title: Rapid Passage
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ILLUSION_SLAYER.title: Illusion Slayer
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ILLUSION_SLAYER.descrip: The target loses {HpLoss:diff()} HP. When you lose [gold]Illusion[/gold], return this card from your Discard Pile to your Hand.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ECHOING_SONG.title: Echoing Song
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ECHOING_SONG.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Double the damage of [gold]Echoing Song[/gold] for the rest of this turn.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_MYSTIC_SECRET.title: Mystic Secret
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_MYSTIC_SECRET.descripti: Draw 1 card. If it is [gold]Ethereal[/gold], play it automatically.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TRUMP_CARD.title: Trump Card
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_TRUMP_CARD.description: Keep 1 card in your Hand. Shuffle all other cards in your Hand into your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_BOTTOM_DEAL.title: Bottom Deal
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_BOTTOM_DEAL.description: Draw 1 card from the bottom of your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_COUNTING.title: Counting
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_COUNTING.description: Put all cards in your Hand on the bottom of your Draw Pile. Draw that many cards.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_DIVINATION.title: Divination
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_DIVINATION.description: Draw 1 card and Exhaust it. If it was [gold]Ethereal[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ETCHED_MEMORY.title: Etched Memory
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_ETCHED_MEMORY.descripti: One card offered in this combat's rewards gains a random [gold]Etching[/gold], [gold]Perfect Fit[/gold], [gold]Swift[/gold] 1, or [gold]Steady[/gold] enchantment.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_INFINITE_TIMBRE.title: Infinite Timbre
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_INFINITE_TIMBRE.descrip: Whenever you play an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card, draw 1 card.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FORMLESS_WINGS.title: Formless Wings
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FORMLESS_WINGS.descript: Whenever you play the last card in your Hand, ALL enemies lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_BLENDING_IN.title: Blending In
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_BLENDING_IN.description:
Whenever you lose 1 [gold]Illusion[/gold], draw 1 card.
Gain {MercuriusIllusionPower:diff()} [gold]Illusion[/gold].
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_SONG_OF_REST.title: Song of Rest
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_IN_A_FOG.title: In a Fog
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_IN_A_FOG.description: At the end of your turn, if you have an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card in your Hand, gain 1 [gold]Illusion[/gold].
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_POWER_WORD.title: Word of Power
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_POWER_WORD.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has 100 HP or less afterward, Stun it.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FATES_END.title: Fate's End
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_FATES_END.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy. Draw 1 card. If it is [gold]Ethereal[/gold], repeat.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_AVATAR_OF_STORIES.title: Once Upon a Time
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_AVATAR_OF_STORIES.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. The next off-color card you play this turn is played twice.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_PERFECT_TIMBRE.title: Perfect Timbre
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_PERFECT_TIMBRE.descript: At the start of your turn, draw 1 card, then put 1 card from your Hand on the bottom of your Draw Pile.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_WALKING_TOGETHER.title: Walking Together
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_WALKING_TOGETHER.descri: Whenever you [gold]Tune[/gold], all other players draw 1 card.
Whenever you play an off-color card, gain 1 Strength and Dexterity.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_WHOLE_PRESENCE.title: Whole Presence
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_WHOLE_PRESENCE.descript: Whenever you [gold]Tune[/gold] or shuffle your Draw Pile, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_JOURNEY_MEMORIES.title: Journey Memories
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_JOURNEY_MEMORIES.descri: After victory, gain an additional reward offering 1 of 3 off-color cards.
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_PERFECT_FINALE.title: Perfect Finale
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_PHANTOM_DUPLICATE.title: Phantom Duplicate
STS2WD-MERCURIUS_PHANTOM_DUPLICATE.descr: Each turn, add an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of the first card you play to your Hand.
